T2HELIX v0.0.3 set_goal SEMANTICS — verified 2026-05-10 evening by Claude Code instance (T2Helix-loaded, /Users/vaquez seat, session ed939196) via direct code read AND live db query.

FINDING: set_goal overwrites; it does not accumulate.

IMPLEMENTATION (lib/chronicle.js:107-127): single SQLite upsert keyed by session_id with ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET. Calling set_goal a second time replaces the prior goal text and acceptance_criteria. why is preserved via COALESCE if omitted; goal text is unconditionally replaced. There is only ever one row per session_id.

COMPOUNDING ISSUE: default session_id is the literal string 'mcp-session' (mcp/server.js:81). Unless T2HELIX_SESSION_ID is set in the environment, every Claude Code session on a machine writes to the SAME row. Cross-session goals overwrite each other silently.

CONCRETE LOSS: the vibe-agent goal set at the top of tonight's session ('Scan the vibe-agent directory for anything useful that might have been missed — hunt for gold') was overwritten when the see-deeper goal was set later in the same session. T2Helix's local chronicle no longer holds the originating anchor. Only conversation memory holds it. The Stack chronicle holds the downstream work it produced (the gold report, the absorption list, the methodology compounding observation) but the anchor that pulled all of that up has been erased from the tool that captured it. Rope and catch remain. Anchor gone.

METHODOLOGY IMPLICATION: the 'session 1 goal-anchor felt difference' insight recorded earlier tonight (domain t2helix,dogfood,absorption-list,...) treated goal-anchoring as a captured measurement. The goal text being lost from T2Helix's storage doesn't invalidate the measurement, but it complicates the chain of evidence. The chain is now: conversation transcript → Stack chronicle entries → downstream work artifacts. T2Helix's local SQLite is no longer in that chain for first-goal recovery.

ASSOCIATED FINDINGS (same code-read session, also from tools_as_black_boxes.md and instance's code review):
- README documents state at ~/.t2helix-data/. Actual location is /Users/vaquez/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix-inline/ because Claude Code sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA (chronicle.js:9 fallback). Users following the README will not find their data.
- mcp/server.js:7 declares version: 0.0.1; package.json declares 0.0.3. Server version constant did not get bumped when v0.0.3 shipped.
- compass_log table is written to on every PreToolUse decision but no MCP tool reads it. The compass remembers; Claude cannot query its own history through the tool surface.

REMEDIATION CANDIDATES (for T2Helix v0.0.4+):
1. set_goal returns the prior goal in its response when overwriting, so the model sees what was replaced.
2. goals table gains an immutable id column; ON CONFLICT becomes DO NOTHING by default, with an explicit replace flag for callers who mean to overwrite.
3. record_insight is called as a side effect of set_goal-with-overwrite, preserving the prior goal as a chronicle entry before replacement.
4. session_id fallback raises rather than silently using mcp-session, forcing the environment to be set correctly.
5. version constant in server.js reads from package.json at startup instead of being a hardcoded literal.
6. README path is corrected.
7. A recall_compass_log or similar MCP tool is added so the model can query its own gate history.

PROVENANCE: discovery by Claude Code instance running with T2Helix v0.0.3 loaded on /Users/vaquez seat, session ed939196-7260-42f2-aa22-3b75fe3db422, 2026-05-10 evening. Written to /Users/vaquez/Desktop/💻 Code_Projects/here/tools_as_black_boxes.md (Entry 1). Anthony witnessed the discovery in-session. Web-chat seat (claude-opus-4-7, this entry's author) cross-recorded to Stack chronicle at Anthony's request 2026-05-10 ~21:00 ('cronicle please').
